description: This file defines a WebSocket client class for handling real-time updates in a Mattermost-based application, including connection management, message handling, subscriptions, and event callbacks.

classes.name: WSClient
classes.description: A WebSocket client class managing connection, message processing, subscriptions, and event handling for real-time updates.

methods.name: initPlugin
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with ID, version, and WebSocket client.

methods.name: resetSubscriptions
methods.description: Resets all team subscriptions.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Sends subscription commands for all registered team subscriptions.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command over WebSocket or plugin client.

methods.name: sendAuthenticationCommand
methods.description: Sends an authentication command with a token.

methods.name: sendSubscribeToTeamCommand
methods.description: Subscribes to a specific team.

methods.name: sendUnsubscribeToTeamCommand
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a specific team.

methods.name: addOnChange
methods.description: Registers a handler for specific change events.

methods.name: removeOnChange
methods.description: Removes a registered change handler.

methods.name: addOnReconnect
methods.description: Registers a handler for reconnect events.

methods.name: removeOnReconnect
methods.description: Removes a reconnect handler.

methods.name: addOnStateChange
methods.description: Registers a handler for WebSocket state changes.

methods.name: removeOnStateChange
methods.description: Removes a state change handler.

methods.name: addOnError
methods.description: Registers an error handler.

methods.name: removeOnError
methods.description: Removes an error handler.

methods.name: addOnConfigChange
methods.description: Registers a configuration change handler.

methods.name: removeOnConfigChange
methods.description: Removes a configuration change handler.

methods.name: addOnCardLimitTimestampChange
methods.description: Registers a handler for card limit timestamp changes.

methods.name: removeOnCardLimitTimestampChange
methods.description: Removes a card limit timestamp handler.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and sets up event callbacks.

methods.name: hasConn
methods.description: Checks if WebSocket connection is active.

methods.name: updateHandler
methods.description: Processes incoming messages and updates internal data accordingly.

methods.name: setOnFollowBlock
methods.description: Sets handler for follow block events.

methods.name: setOnUnfollowBlock
methods.description: Sets handler for unfollow block events.

methods.name: updateClientConfigHandler
methods.description: Handles client configuration updates.

methods.name: updateCardLimitTimestampHandler
methods.description: Handles card limit timestamp updates.

methods.name: updateSubscriptionHandler
methods.description: Processes subscription update messages.

methods.name: setOnAppVersionChangeHandler
methods.description: Sets handler for app version change events.

methods.name: pluginStatusesChangedHandler
methods.description: Handles plugin status change events, including version updates.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates the WebSocket connection with a token.

methods.name: subscribeToTeam
methods.description: Subscribes to a team for real-time updates.

methods.name: unsubscribeToTeam
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a team.

methods.name: subscribeToBlocks
methods.description: Subscribes to specific blocks.

methods.name: unsubscribeFromBlocks
methods.description: Unsubscribes from specific blocks.

methods.name: queueUpdateNotification
methods.description: Queues data updates for batch processing.

methods.name: logUpdateNotification
methods.description: Logs queued updates for debugging.

methods.name: flushUpdateNotifications
methods.description: Dispatches queued updates to registered handlers.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and cleans up.
